base: Use case: ui-mockup. High-end real desktop website section, ONE standalone horizontal 16:9 frame, full bleed without browser/device mockup or presentation labels. Brand AXON ENJIN, product Operating Layer. Brand concept: axon = nerves carrying a signal; Enjin = where people connect through technology. A living network, not a brain illustration or blockchain globe. Strict palette: void black #04060d, navy panel #0a1424, cobalt #2e6fff, cyan #56c8ff, ice #cfe3ff, white headings. No gold, copper, warm cream, purple or green. Refined DM Sans/Garet-like normal-medium sans, generous tracking control and negative space; optional Instrument Serif italic only for a deliberate headline emphasis, as specifically requested by the Forma reference. Preserve AXON ENJIN condensed text wordmark with tiny cyan signal dot. Avoid huge condensed shouting headlines, generic SaaS cards, fake stats, invented client logos, microscopic UI and gratuitous neon. Atmospheric light limited to the meaningful signal. Thin rules, technical chapter labels, small ✳ marker. This is a visual proposal; no app code.

SECTION 1 OF 8: HERO / THE FIRST SIGNAL. Generate the flagship design, art directed like Forma's cinematic particle sculpture but uniquely Axon. Input image 1 is Forma art-direction reference only (sculptural scale, restraint), NOT its brand or gold palette. Input image 2 is Axon's existing site reference for palette, wordmark and blue pill control DNA only, NOT its crowded card layout or Anton headings.
Beautiful extremely dark spatial canvas. Very faint 1px technical grid with large cells, subtle cobalt atmospheric depth, a thin cobalt page-progress line on very top. At top 55px down: AXON ENJIN wordmark left; elegant unboxed small navigation 'Product', 'Modules', 'Company' toward right, cobalt pill 'Talk to us ↗' at right edge. Thin header rule. 72px horizontal outer margins.
Main artwork dominates the CENTER and lower-right: hundreds of impossibly fine blue/cyan light filaments resembling a magnified axon tract, sweeping from lower-left as a single bundled strand, dividing into three organic arcing branches with tiny synaptic nodes at the ends. Sculptural tension and volume from layered hairline particles, no solid metallic object, no sphere, no generic dot mesh. One small bright white-cyan impulse travelling along the trunk. Lots of void around it; detail is extraordinary, not oversaturated. The branches suggest people connecting, no literal faces or bodies. It is a meaningful living neural pathway, not decorative particle rain.
Type sits top-left below nav and overlaps only the empty dark left area: small technical label '✳ TECHNOLOGY THAT CONNECTS'; large elegant 100px line 'People,' in white normal-medium sans, second line 'connected.' in luminous ice Instrument Serif italic, not bold. Total headline two lines, clean generous leading and safe italic descenders. Below 20px readable support 'One system for every branch.' then 'Add the tools you need.' At lower-left under support cobalt compact pill 'See modules ↗' alongside quiet white text 'Talk to us'. Do not show a dashboard, textarea, composer or catalog in this hero.
Bottom-left small tracking label 'AXON / 01'; bottom-center tiny 'Scroll to follow the signal ↓'; bottom-right tasteful small outlined 'Ⅱ Motion on' control. The fibre sculpture occupies about 50 percent canvas but does not cross copy. This must feel like a visually extraordinary actual homepage first screen, quiet precision rather than gaming/cyberpunk.

SECTION 3 OF 8: MANIFESTO / THE HUMAN CONNECTION. Use attached hero strictly for brand palette, fine signal treatment and typography. Create the quietest section in the set. No nav, no product window, no cards, no buttons except the global bottom-right outlined 'Ⅱ Motion on'. 72px horizontal margins. A typography-led manifesto occupying the middle 70% of screen, slightly offset left from center, huge 64px normal-weight DM Sans/Garet-like clean sans with generous leading, comfortable lines. Exact copy with deliberate breaks:
'Technology should bring'
'people together.'
'Across teams. Across branches.'
'So everyone can work'
'from the same page.'
Show an elegant mid-scroll word-reveal state: first two lines fully white, third line ice blue, last two lines muted blue-gray still legible. Highlight only 'together.' in the same typography with a thin cyan under-rule, not a new font. The future reveal is implied by progressive color, not extra UI.
At far left a narrow vertical small caption 'THE CONNECTION IS HUMAN' reads upward as a distinctive editorial side note, not large decoration. A SINGLE fine cobalt nerve strand travels across bottom quarter from left edge to right with three small white/cyan nodes, gently branching once below text, almost like an understated underline of the whole statement. Little to no bloom. At bottom-left small readable support 'Axon carries the signal. Enjin is where we connect.' Keep plenty of black negative space above and below. This should feel profound, human and expertly typeset, not a motivational poster, sci-fi dashboard or glowing diagram. ONE section only.
